title: ObjectFFRF.sparseMassMatrix replaces exudyn.special.solver.superElementSparseMassMatrix
author: Claude-JG
description: The switch between the sparse and the dense mass matrix of ObjectFFRF (#2183) belongs to the object, as a parameter that is kept with the model, not to exudyn.special.
releaseNotes: ObjectFFRF.sparseMassMatrix (default True) switches between the mass matrix as sparse triplets and the dense matrix; it replaces exu.special.solver.superElementSparseMassMatrix
